summary: params dynamically updates deflate compression level and strategy; its specified applicability is deflate-family compression rather than Brotli.

target.notes: Preserve Node stream/error behavior. Do not infer applicability merely from JavaScript property presence on a stream object.

semantics.callback: invoked after parameter transition is processed
semantics.brotli: Brotli uses its own parameter model; generic method presence is not evidence of compatible semantics

caveats: Calling inherited surface methods on incompatible codec objects may fail through stream/codec error behavior; do not compile them as valid Brotli parameter changes.

tests.name: deflate params
tests.expected_behavior: callback runs after valid deflate parameter update

tests.name: brotli boundary
tests.input: const z=require('node:zlib'); const s=z.createBrotliCompress(); console.log(typeof s.params);
tests.expected_behavior: surface presence does not make zlib level/strategy semantics valid for Brotli
